<form action="{{form_action}}" method="POST" class="contact">
  <label>Name<input name="name" required></label>
  <label>Email<input name="email" type="email" required></label>
  <label>Subject<input name="subject" required></label>
  <label>Message<textarea name="message" rows="5" required></textarea></label>
  <button type="submit">Send</button>
</form>
<style>
  .contact { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .75rem; max-width: 480px; }
  .contact label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .25rem; font-size: .9rem; }
  .contact input, .contact textarea { padding: .5rem; border: 1px solid #ccc; border-radius: 4px; }
  .contact button { padding: .6rem; background: #111; color: white; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; }
</style>
summary_zh: HTML 聯絡表單含基本樣式
